title: A facile approach to deposit high performance electrocatalyst high entropy oxide coatings using a novel plasma spray route for efficient water splitting in an alkaline medium
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00479A, Paper
Amarnath Pasupathi, Praveen Kandasamy, Ranjith Kumar Dharman, Sivakumar Govindarajan, Tae Hwan Oh, Min Wook Lee, Yugeswaran Subramaniam
These pioneering efforts propose an innovative and additive-free approach for depositing diverse metal oxide coatings including high entropy oxides with a desirable phase and microstructure for energy storage and conversion applications.
